1.1: Arbaa rashe shanim hem. beechad benisan rosh hashshana lammelachim velargalim. beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim, beechad betishre. beechad betishre rosh hashshana lashshanim velashshemittin velayyovlot, lannetia velayrakot. beechad bishvat, rosh hashshana lailan, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, bachamishsha asar bo:
1.2: Bearbaa ferakim haolam niddon, befesach al hattevua, baatzeret al perot hailan, berosh hashshana kol bae haolam ovrin lefanav kivne maron, shenneemar (tehillim log) hayyotzer yachad libbam, hammevin el kol maasehem. uvechag niddonin al hammayim:
1.3: Al shishsha chodashim hashsheluchin yotzin, al nisan mippene happesach, al av mippene hattaanit, al elul mippene rosh hashshana, al tishre mippene takkanat hammoadot, al kislev mippene chanukka, veal adar mippene happurim. ucheshehaya vet hammikdash kayyam, yotzin af al iyyar mippene fesach katan:
1.4: Al shene chodashim mechallelin et hashshabbat, al nisan veal tishre, shebbahen hashsheluchin yotzin lesureya, uvahen metakkenin et hammoadot. ucheshehaya vet hammikdash kayyam, mechallelin af al kullan mippene takkanat hakkarban:
1.5: Ben shennira vaalil ben shello nira vaalil, mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, rabbi yose omer, im nira vaalil, en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat:
1.6: Maase sheavru yoter mearbaim zug, veikkevan rabbi akiva velud. shalach lo rabban gamliel, im meakkev atta et harabbim, nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo:
1.7: Av uveno sherau et hachodesh, yelchu. lo shemmitztarfin ze im ze, ella sheim yippasel echad mehen, yitztaref hashsheni im acher. rabbi shimon omer, av uveno vechol hakkerovin, kesherin leedut hachodesh. amar rabbi yose, maase vetoviyya harofe, sheraa et hachodesh birushalayim, hu uveno veavdo meshuchrar, vekibbelu hakkohanim oto veet beno, ufaslu et avdo. ucheshebbau lifne vet din, kibbelu oto veet avdo, ufaslu et beno:
1.8: Ellu hen happesulin, hamesachek bekuvya, umalve veribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit, vaavadim. ze hakkelal, kol edut sheen haishsha cheshera lah, af hen enan kesherim lah:
1.9: Mi sheraa et hachodesh veeno yachol lehallech, molichin oto al hachamor, afillu vemitta. veim tzode lahem, lokchin beyadam makkelot. veim hayta derech rechoka, lokchin beyadam mezonot, sheal mahalach layla vayom mechallelin et hashshabbat veyotzin leedut hachodesh, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), elle moade Adonai asher tikreu otam bemoadam:

2.1: Im enan makkirin oto, meshallechin acher immo lahaido. barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam. mishshekkilkelu hamminin, hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella min hammakkirim:
2.2: Barishona hayu massiin massuot. mishshekkilkelu hakkutim, hitkinu sheyyehu sheluchin yotzin:
2.3: Ketzad hayu massiin massuot, meviin kelunsaot shel erez arukkin vekanim vaatze shemen uneoret shel pishtan vechorech bimshicha, veole lerosh hahar umatztzit bahen et haur, umolich umevi umaale umorid, ad shehu roe et chavero shehu ose chen berosh hahar hashsheni, vechen berosh hahar hashshelishi:
2.4: Umeayin hayu massiin massuot, mehar hammishcha lesarteva, umissarteva ligrofina, umiggerofina lechavran, umechavran levet biltin, umibbet biltin lo zazu mishsham, ella molich umevi umaale umorid ad shehaya roe chol haggola lefanav kimdurat haesh:
2.5: Chatzer gedola hayta virushalayim, uvet yazek hayta nikret, ulesham kol haedim mitkannesim, uvet din bodkin otam sham. useudot gedolot osin lahem bishvil sheyyehu regilin lavo. barishona lo hayu zazin mishsham kol hayyom, hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyehu mehallechin alpayim amma lechol ruach. velo ellu vilvad, ella af hachachama habbaa leyalled, vehabba lehatztzil min haddeleka umin haggayis umin hannahar umin hammappolet, hare ellu cheanshe hair, veyesh lahem alpayim amma lechol ruach:
2.6: Ketzad bodkin et haedim. zug shebba rishon, bodkin oto rishon. umachnisin et haggadol shebbahen veomrim lo, emor, ketzad raita et hallevana, lifne hachamma o leachar hachamma, litzfonah o lidromah, kamma haya gavoah uleayin haya note, vechamma haya rachav. im amar lifne hachamma, lo amar kelum. veachar kach hayu machnisim et hashsheni uvodkin oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanim, edutan kayyamet. ushear kol hazzugot shoalin otam rashe devarim, lo shehayu tzerichin lahen, ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh, bishvil sheyyehu regilim lavo:
2.7: Rosh bet din omer mekuddash, vechol haam onin acharav mekuddash mekuddash. ben shennira vizmanno ben shello nira vizmanno, mekaddeshin oto. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, im lo nira vizmanno, en mekaddeshin oto, shekkevar kiddeshuhu shamayim:
2.8: Demut tzurot levanot hayu lo lerabban gamliel battavla uvakkotel baaliyyato, shebbahen mare et hahedyotot veomer, hachaze raita o chaze. maase shebbau shenayim veamru, reinuhu shacharit bammizrach vearvit bammaarav. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ede sheker hem. keshebbau leyavne kibbelan rabban gamliel. veod bau shenayim veamru, reinuhu vizmanno, uvelel ibburo lo nira, vekibbelan rabban gamliel. amar rabbi dosa ben harekinas, ede sheker hen, heach meidin al haishsha sheyyalda, ulemachar keresah ben shinneha. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, roe ani et devarecha:
2.9: Shalach lo rabban gamliel, gozrani alecha shettavo etzli bemakkelcha uvimotecha beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot becheshboncha. halach umetzao rabbi akiva metzer, amar lo, yesh li lilmod shekkol ma sheasa rabban gamliel asuy, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh, asher tikreu otam, ben bizmannan ben shello vizmannan, en li moadot ella ellu. ba lo etzel rabbi dosa ben harekinas, amar lo, im bain anu ladun achar bet dino shel rabban gamliel, tzerichin anu ladun achar kol bet din uvet din sheamad mimot moshe vead achshav, shenneemar (Shemot kad), vayyaal moshe veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivim mizzikne yisrael. velamma lo nitparshu shemotan shel zekenim, ella lelammed, shekkol shelosha ushelosha sheamdu vet din al yisrael, hare hu chevet dino shel moshe. natal maklo umeotav beyado, vehalach leyavne etzel rabban gamliel beyom shechal yom hakkippurim lihyot becheshbono. amad rabban gamliel uneshako al rosho, amar lo, bo veshalom, rabbi vetalmidi, rabbi vechachma, vetalmidi shekkibbalta devaray:

3.1: Rauhu vet din vechol yisrael, nechkeru haedim, velo hispiku lomar mekuddash, ad shechashecha, hare ze meubbar. rauhu vet din bilvad, yaamdu shenayim veyaidu vifnehem, veyomru mekuddash mekuddash. rauhu shelosha vehen bet din, yaamdu hashshenayim veyoshivu mechavrehem etzel hayyachid veyaidu vifnehem, veyomru mekuddash mekuddash, sheen hayyachid neeman al yede atzmo:
3.2: Kol hashshofarot kesherin chutz mishshel para, mippene shehu keren. amar rabbi yose, vahalo chol hashshofarot nikreu keren, shenneemar (yehoshua 6), bimshoch bekeren hayyovel:
3.3: Shofar shel rosh hashshana shel yael, pashut, ufiv metzuppe zahav, ushete chatzotzrot min hatztzedadin. shofar maarich vachatzotzrot mekatztzerot, shemmitzvat hayyom bashshofar:
3.4: Battaaniyyot, beshel zecharim, kefufin, ufihen metzuppe chesef, ushete chatzotzrot baemtza. shofar mekatztzer vachatzotzrot maarichot, shemmitzvat hayyom bachatzotzrot:
3.5: Shave hayyovel lerosh hashshana lattekia velabberachot. rabbi yehuda omer, berosh hashshana tokin beshel zecharim, uvayyovlot beshel yeelim:
3.6: Shofar shennisdak vedibbeko, pasul. dibbek shivre shofarot, pasul. nikkav usetamo, im meakkev et hattekia, pasul. veim lav, kasher:
3.7: Hattokea letoch habbor o letoch haddut o letoch happittas, im kol shofar shama, yatza. veim kol havara shama, lo yatza. vechen mi shehaya over achore vet hakkeneset, o shehaya veto samuch levet hakkeneset, veshama kol shofar o kol megilla, im kivven libbo, yatza, veim lav, lo yatza. af al pi shezze shama veze shama, ze kivven libbo veze lo chivven libbo:
3.8: Vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael vegomer (Shemot 17), vechi yadav shel moshe osot milchama o shovrot milchama. ella lomar lecha, kol zeman shehayu yisrael mistakkelim kelappe mala umeshabedin et libbam laavihem shebbashshamayim hayu mitgabberim. veim lav, hayu noflin. kayyotze vaddavar atta omer (Bamidbar 21), ase lecha saraf vesim oto al nes, vehaya kol hannashuch veraa oto vachay. vechi nachash memit, o nachash mechayye. ella, bizman sheyyisrael mistakkelin kelappe mala umeshabedin et libbam laavihen shebbashshamayim, hayu mitrappeim, veim lav, hayu nimmokim. cheresh, shote, vekatan, en motziin et harabbim yede chovatan. ze hakkelal, kol sheeno mechuyyav baddavar, eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan:

4.1: Yom tov shel rosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat, bammikdash hayu tokim, aval lo vammedina. meshshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheyyehu tokin bechol makom sheyyesh bo vet din. amar rabbi elazar, lo hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay ella veyavne bilvad. amru lo, echad yavne veechad kol makom sheyyesh bo vet din:
4.2: Veod zot hayta yerushalayim yetera al yavne, shekkol ir shehi roa veshomaat ukerova vichola lavo, tokin. uveyavne lo hayu tokin ella bevet din bilvad:
4.3: Barishona haya hallulav nittal bammikdash shiva, uvammedina yom echad. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyhe lulav nittal bammedina shiva zecher lammikdash, vesheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur:
4.4: Barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom. paam achat nishtahu haedim millavo, venitkalkelu haleviyyim bashshir. hitkinu shello yehu mekabbelin ella ad hammincha. veim bau edim min hammincha ulemala, nohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulemachar kodesh. mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheyyehu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom. amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha, veod zot hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheafillu rosh bet din bechol makom, shello yehu haedim holchin ella limkom havvaad:
4.5: Seder berachot, omer avot ugevurot ukedushshat hashshem, vecholel malchuyot immahen, veeno tokea. kedushshat hayyom, vetokea. zichronot, vetokea. shofarot, vetokea. veomer avoda vehodaa uvirkat kohanim, divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri. amar lo rabbi akiva, im eno tokea lammalchuyot, lamma hu mazkir. ella omer avot ugevurot ukedushshat hashshem, vecholel malchuyot im kedushshat hayyom, vetokea. zichronot, vetokea. shofarot, vetokea. veomer avoda vehodaa uvirkat kohanim:
4.6: En pochatin measara malchuyot, measara zichronot, measara shofarot. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, im amar shalosh shalosh mikkullan, yatza. en mazkirin zikkaron malchut veshofar shel puranut. matchil battora umashlim bannavi. rabbi yose omer, im hishlim battora, yatza:
4.7: Haover lifne hatteva beyom tov shel rosh hashshana, hashsheni matkia. uvishat hahallel, rishon makre et hahallel:
4.8: Shofar shel rosh hashshana, en maavirin alav et hattechum, veen mefakkechin alav et haggal, lo olin beilan, velo rochvin al gabbe vehema, velo shatin al pene hammayim, veen chotchin oto ben bedavar shehu mishshum shevut, uven bedavar shehu mishshum lo taase. aval im ratza litten letocho mayim o yayin, yitten. en meakkevin et hattinokot millitkoa, aval mitassekin immahen ad sheyyilmedu. vehammitassek, lo yatza, vehashshomea min hammitassek, lo yatza:
4.9: Seder tekiot, shalosh, shel shalosh shalosh. shiur tekia keshalosh teruot. shiur terua keshalosh yevavot. taka barishona, umashach bashsheniyya chishtayim, en beyado ella echat. mi shebberach veachar kach nitmanna lo shofar, tokea umeria vetokea shalosh peamim. keshem sheshsheliach tzibbur chayyav, kach kol yachid veyachid chayyav. rabban gamliel omer, sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatan:
